title: K-flat normalization and tensor coherence of open scalar comparisons
statement: Let j:U→X be an arbitrary open immersion and φ:A→B a homomorphism of commutative rings. Write L_A=j_!, J_A=j^*, F_φ,T=−⊗^L_A B, Q_T for localization of cochain complexes, E_φ,T for ordinary scalar extension, and c_φ,T(P):F_φ,T(Q_T P)→Q_T(E_φ,T P) for its scalar representative map. Use exactly the maps and normalization predicates fixed in [lem-coef-etale-open-comparison-data], and the scalar tensor comparison t_T(M,N):F_φ,T M⊗^L_B F_φ,T N→F_φ,T(M⊗^L_A N) of [lem-coef-etale-hom-thick-locus]. Let q_φ:L_A F_φ,X→F_φ,U L_B and r_φ:J_A F_φ,U→F_φ,X J_B be the fixed natural isomorphisms (functors are written in diagrammatic order). Then q_φ satisfies OpenScalarExtensionNormalization φ j, and it is the unique natural isomorphism satisfying that predicate. Likewise r_φ satisfies OpenScalarRestrictionNormalization φ j and is uniquely determined by it. Equivalently, on every K-flat P, the two paths built from q_φ (respectively r_φ), the scalar representative maps c, the exact localization factors for L (respectively J), and Q of the degreewise ordinary q-zero (respectively r-zero), coincide as specified in those predicates. For any ψ:B→C, let a_T:F_φ,T F_ψ,T≅F_(ψφ),T be the fixed scalar composition comparison. For every P in D(U_et,A), using ';' to compose from left to right, F_ψ,X(q_φ,P); q_ψ,F_φ,U(P); L_C(a_U,P) = a_X,L_A(P); q_(ψφ),P. Finally, for every P in D(U_et,A) and T in D(X_et,A), the exact open projection γ obeys the explicit mixed square: γ_B(F_φ,U P,F_φ,X T); (q_φ,P^(-1)⊗id); t_X(L_A P,T) = L_B((id⊗r_φ,T^(-1));t_U(P,J_A T)); q_φ,(P⊗J_A T)^(-1); F_φ,X(γ_A(P,T)). There are no boundedness, constructibility, flat coefficient-map, or quasi-compact-open hypotheses.
